items.title: Exact volume density of the actual Gaussian with SPD precision

source.anchor: Eq4, Appendix B.2.2 density p_O of N(0,A_O^-1), and Eq26 regularity. Standard SPD Gaussian density background is expanded explicitly.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling; the generic SPD identity is standard Gaussian background, not a new all-matrices theorem attributed to the paper.

items.statement: For every natural n, including zero, and every real symmetric positive-definite n by n precision matrix A, the actual canonical centered multivariate Gaussian with covariance A inverse equals canonical Euclidean volume with density sqrt(det A)/(2pi)^(n/2) exp(-x^T A x/2). The exponent n/2 is real division. Coordinates are WithLp.ofLp of the genuine Euclidean vector. No density, Jacobian, inverse, square-root or normalization fact is assumed beyond A.PosDef. This is a standard background generalization used by the source density assertion.
assumptions: Every natural dimension n, including n=0.
A is a real SPD precision matrix: this is the legitimate domain of the standard background theorem.
Existing canonical multivariateGaussian and stdGaussian, actual Euclidean volume, true Euclidean norm, nonnegative square root and real dimension-half powers.

obligations.label: Actual canonical Gaussian equals exact Euclidean-volume density

bindings.boundary: Exact actual Gaussian-law/volume-density identification only. Target-mixture construction and its relation to H and TV, sphere/Poisson, parameter choice, amplification/transcript, fixed-spectrum hidden-eigenbasis and both main lower bounds remain open. No determinant-sign lower bound is transported to the eigenbasis route.

assumption_deltas.source: Standard nondegenerate Gaussian density used implicitly in Appendix B.2.2.
assumption_deltas.lean: Every natural n and any real SPD precision, including dimension zero, for the existing actual constructor.
assumption_deltas.reason: A canonical reusable background generalization, explicitly distinguished from the source-specific assertion. Its immediate actual consumer is the determinant-family adapter; the fixed-spectrum route is only a planned second consumer.

items.title: Identify the source Gaussian law with its literal precision density

source.anchor: Eq4, Appendix B.2.2 density p_O of N(0,A_O^-1), and Eq26 regularity. Standard SPD Gaussian density background is expanded explicitly.
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, On Complexity of Gaussian Sampling; the generic SPD identity is standard Gaussian background, not a new all-matrices theorem attributed to the paper.

items.statement: For every natural n>=3, real kappa>=4 and every member O of the full real orthogonal group, let A_O=((kappa+1)/2)I-((kappa-1)/4)(O+O transpose). The actual canonical centered multivariate Gaussian with covariance A_O inverse equals canonical Euclidean volume with density sqrt(det A_O)/(2pi)^(n/2) exp(-x^T A_O x/2), using real n/2. Positive definiteness is proved from the existing exact lower quadratic bound; it is not an extra premise supplied by the caller. Both determinant signs are allowed.
assumptions: n>=3 and kappa>=4, exactly the standing source range.
Every member of full real O(n), with both determinant signs.
No caller SPD, inverse, density, Jacobian or normalization premise. Existing source regularity supplies strict SPD internally.

obligations.label: Actual canonical Gaussian equals exact Euclidean-volume density

bindings.boundary: Exact actual Gaussian-law/volume-density identification only. Target-mixture construction and its relation to H and TV, sphere/Poisson, parameter choice, amplification/transcript, fixed-spectrum hidden-eigenbasis and both main lower bounds remain open. No determinant-sign lower bound is transported to the eigenbasis route.

assumption_deltas.source: Standing n>=3,kappa>=4, full O(n) and the Eq4 precision.
assumption_deltas.lean: Same standing range and actual precision; strict SPD proved internally from exact lower bound, not added as a premise.
assumption_deltas.reason: The same source Gaussian and exact density on actual Euclidean volume.
